without.title: Without Duotail
items: A new Gmail account every time the old one gets buried
Rummaging through Promotions, Updates and Social tabs
Thousands of unread emails, most of them expired deals
Every sign-up adds to the pile, and it never shrinks

with.title: With *Duotail*
items: One inbox for life, behind an address you can publish
Only senders you allowed get through. The rest never land
Every email shows which address it came to, so you know why it's there
Mute a noisy sender in one click, unmute when you want them back

closing: An inbox that stays lean is an inbox you never have to abandon.
